changes: Root cause confirmed in pkg/logx: the standard log bridge emits every record at INFO, including log.Fatal output. At LOG_LEVEL=error the process still exited but its critical reason was filtered out.

Added logx.Fatal, resolving the current default logger at call time, recording ERROR with component and a separately redacted error field, bounded-flushing the existing optional Sentry pipeline and exiting with code 1. Uses existing pkg.ErrText/RedactSecrets; no new logging stack or dependency.

Migrated application boot/frontend/init, LiveKit seed and unrecoverable server/shutdown exits to this path. Ordinary stdlib messages retain their existing INFO behavior; severity is not guessed from arbitrary text. The standalone resize utility, which does not initialize this log bridge, retains its existing standard fatal path.
verification: Subprocess tests verify actual exit status 1, visible ERROR severity with JSON/text configuration at LOG_LEVEL=error, use before Init, component context and masking of a synthetic authToken value.
